test_objective: The Notification content shall be JSON-LD when endpoint.accept is set to JSON-LD

test_cases.name: 046_14_01 Check that a notification is sent as JSON-LD
test_cases.doc: The Notification content shall be JSON-LD when endpoint.accept is set to 'application/ld+json'
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to '${fragment_filename}' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
